author: Ari K.
text: Quality justifies most of the price, though I'd expect a carry case included at this tier.

author: Mia P.
text: I bought this as a gift and had to apologise for the state of the box. Please invest in the unboxing, it's part of what people pay for here.

author: Nora W.
text: I hesitated at the price and still think it's high, but I use it daily so the cost per shot has worked out fine.

author: Marlo K.
text: Second order and again the box was damaged in transit. The product survives but it undercuts the premium feel.

author: Marlo C.
text: Crema is thick and stable, extraction is even, and it handles a fine grind without complaint.

author: Lena C.
text: The industrial design is a step above everything else in this category.

author: Levi D.
text: Excellent build and excellent coffee. It feels like a considered product rather than a gadget.

author: Bree C.
text: Consistently excellent coffee. After two months of daily use the quality hasn't drifted at all.

author: Noah E.
text: It's a genuinely good machine but the direct price is steep compared to marketplace listings for similar portables.

author: Lily P.
text: The packaging didn't match the brand's aesthetic at all — thin cardboard, no insert, machine loose inside. Mine arrived scratched.

author: Milo H.
text: Genuinely cafe-quality shots. I bought a second one for the office.

author: Fern T.
text: The team followed up a week after delivery to check the machine was working well. Nice touch that you don't get from marketplaces.

author: Arlo R.
text: The taste is remarkable for something this size. My partner switched from the cafe down the road to this.

author: Elsa M.
text: Pricey for what it is, but the coffee quality and the support have made it feel worthwhile.

author: Arlo L.
text: Rich, full-bodied espresso every morning. Heats in under a minute and cleans up in seconds.

author: Roscoe E.
text: Machine is lovely but arrived with a dented base. The inner packaging offers no real protection for something this heavy.

author: Drew S.
text: Strong, aromatic shots with a proper crema layer. Exceeded what I expected.

author: Nash C.
text: It looks lovely on the counter and takes almost no space. Form and function both handled.

author: Sol Z.
text: Genuinely well designed — the finish, the weight, the way the lid closes. Feels premium.

author: Ethan P.
text: Packaging is the weak link. Everything else about buying direct has been excellent.

author: Maud M.
text: The design is beautiful. It's the only appliance I don't hide in a cupboard.

author: Ava N.
text: The flavour profile is smooth and rounded. Best espresso I've made at home, easily.

author: Finn R.
text: I've been pulling shots at home for years and this holds its own against proper equipment. The flavour is clean with no bitterness.

author: Marlo A.
text: Two months in and every shot is as good as the first. Very impressed with the consistency.

author: Greta M.
text: Support answered a descaling question within the hour with a proper detailed reply. Rare these days and it made me trust the brand.

author: Sol A.
text: Ordering direct from the brand I expected a nicer unboxing, but the box arrived crushed on one corner and the machine had a visible dent. For a premium DTC price this matters.

author: Iris P.
text: My unit arrived damaged and they shipped a replacement before I'd even returned the first. Excellent service.

author: Dex E.
text: Elegant, compact, and it photographs well which is why I found the brand in the first place.

author: Milo F.
text: The espresso is outstanding. Thick crema, balanced extraction, and completely consistent shot after shot. It replaced a machine that cost three times as much.

author: Posy N.
text: Beautiful product, disappointing presentation. The outer box was torn and there was no protective padding whatsoever.
